checks.name: frmStudentSearch/cboClass Unicode SQL marker
checks.actual: SELECT 0 AS option_value,'すべて' AS option_name,0 AS option_group,0 AS class_year,0 AS grade_order,0 AS class_order,'' AS class_code FROM t_write_guard WHERE guard_id=1 UNION ALL SELECT class_id,CStr(school_year) & ' ' & g.code_name & ' ' & c.class_code & ' ' & class_name & IIf(c.is_active AND c.valid_from<='2026-10-12' AND c.valid_to>='2026-10-12','',' [停止・期間外]'),1,school_year,g.display_order,c.display_order,c.class_code FROM m_class AS c INNER JOIN m_code AS g ON c.grade_category=g.category_id AND c.grade_code=g.code_value WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY option_group,class_year DESC,grade_order,class_order,class_code,option_value

checks.name: frmStudentEdit/cboClass Unicode SQL marker
checks.actual: SELECT class_id,CStr(school_year) & ' ' & class_code & ' ' & class_name & IIf(is_active AND valid_from<='2026-10-12' AND valid_to>='2026-10-12','',' [停止・期間外]') FROM m_class WHERE 1=1 AND school_year=2026 AND (is_active=True AND valid_from<='2026-10-12' AND valid_to>='2026-10-12') ORDER BY school_year,display_order,class_code,class_id

checks.name: frmStudentEdit/cboGender Unicode SQL marker
checks.actual: SELECT c.code_value,c.code_name & IIf(c.is_active AND k.is_active AND c.valid_from<='2026-10-12' AND (c.valid_to Is Null OR c.valid_to>='2026-10-12'),'',' [停止・期間外]') FROM m_code AS c INNER JOIN m_code_category AS k ON c.category_id=k.category_id WHERE c.category_id='GENDER' AND c.is_active=True AND k.is_active=True AND c.valid_from<='2026-10-12' AND (c.valid_to Is Null OR c.valid_to>='2026-10-12') ORDER BY c.display_order,c.code_value
